description: Scaffold the project skeleton and implement the service layer (config, model, prediction, image, history services) plus utilities. This is the foundation — FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on it.
steps: 1. Create directory structure: src/, src/services/, src/ui/, src/utils/, database/, assets/icons/, tests/ — use os.makedirs or pathlib.Path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) from the workspace root c:\Users\Mahek\Traffic-Sign-Recognition\
2. Create src/__init__.py, src/services/__init__.py, src/ui/__init__.py, src/utils/__init__.py, tests/__init__.py — all empty files to mark packages.

3. Create src/config.py — centralizes all paths and constants. Must include: BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent (resolves to workspace root). MODEL_PATH = BASE_DIR / 'my_model.h5'. SIGNS_PATH = BASE_DIR / 'signs.py'. DATASET_DIR = BASE_DIR / 'datasettraffic'. DATABASE_DIR = BASE_DIR / 'database'. HISTORY_FILE = DATABASE_DIR / 'history.json'. LOG_DIR = BASE_DIR / 'logs'. IMG_SIZE = (32, 32). NUM_CLASSES = 43. CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.60 (default, overridable from settings). MAX_HISTORY = 100. SUPPORTED_FORMATS = ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.bmp'). MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB = 10. Color constants matching the design spec: BG='#0B1120', SIDEBAR='#111827', CARD='#1E293B', etc. Window constants: WINDOW_W=1280, WINDOW_H=800, MIN_W=1024, MIN_H=700.

4. Create src/utils/logging_config.py — sets up Python logging: rotating file handler in logs/app.log (max 2MB, 3 backups) + stream handler. Provides get_logger(name) function. Call logging.captureWarnings(True) to suppress TF deprecation noise.

5. Create src/utils/validators.py — ImageValidator class with static methods: validate_file(path) -> (bool, str error_msg): checks file exists, extension in SUPPORTED_FORMATS, file size <= MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB, file is not zero bytes. validate_image(pil_image) -> (bool, str): checks image is not None, has valid mode, dimensions > 0.

6. Create src/services/model_service.py — ModelService singleton. Constructor: sets TF_ENABLE_ONEDNN_OPTS=0 via os.environ BEFORE importing keras (do this at module top level). Loads model with 'from keras.models import load_model; self._model = load_model(str(MODEL_PATH))'. Exposes: load() -> None (idempotent, logs load time), predict(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray (calls self._model.predict(x, verbose=0)), get_model_info() -> dict with keys input_shape, output_shape, num_layers, total_params, model_path, file_size_mb. Thread safety note: model.predict is called from background thread — Keras/TF with TF 2.15 is thread-safe for predict() after model is loaded on main thread; load on startup from main thread, predict from worker thread without locks is acceptable.

7. Create src/services/prediction_service.py — PredictionService class. Depends on ModelService instance (injected). Imports signs.classes from signs.py at workspace root (use sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR)) before import). Key method: predict(pil_image: PIL.Image.Image) -> dict. Pipeline exactly: img = pil_image.convert('L') → img = img.resize((32,32), PIL.Image.LANCZOS) → arr = np.array(img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0 → arr = np.expand_dims(arr, axis=-1) → arr = np.expand_dims(arr, axis=0) → probs = model_service.predict(arr)[0] → pred_class = int(np.argmax(probs)) → confidence = float(probs[pred_class]) → top3 = sorted enumerate of all 43, top 3 by prob → lookup label with signs.classes[pred_class + 1]. Return dict: {predicted_class: int, predicted_label: str, confidence: float, top3: [{class_id, label, probability}], is_low_confidence: bool (confidence < CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD), processing_time_ms: float}.

8. Create src/services/image_service.py — ImageService class. Methods: load_image(path: str) -> PIL.Image.Image (with try/except, raises ValueError with friendly message on corrupt/invalid file). get_image_info(path: str, pil_image: PIL.Image.Image) -> dict with keys: filename, filepath, dimensions (WxH string), file_size_kb, mode, format. resize_for_display(pil_image, max_size=(400,400)) -> PIL.Image.Image (maintains aspect ratio using thumbnail).

9. Create src/services/history_service.py — HistoryService class. Stores prediction records as JSON list in database/history.json. Methods: add_record(record: dict) -> None (appends, trims to MAX_HISTORY, saves); get_all() -> list[dict] (newest first); get_stats() -> dict with total_predictions, most_common_sign, avg_confidence, today_count; clear_history() -> None; export_csv(path: str) -> None. Creates database/ dir if missing. Thread-safe via threading.Lock.

10. Create run.py at workspace root c:\Users\Mahek\Traffic-Sign-Recognition\run.py — entry point. Sets os.environ['TF_ENABLE_ONEDNN_OPTS']='0' as FIRST line before any other imports. Sets sys.path so 'src' and workspace root are importable. Calls setup_logging(). Instantiates ModelService, loads model, creates App (passing model_service), calls app.mainloop().

11. Create requirements.txt at workspace root listing pinned versions of all required packages: tensorflow==2.15.1, keras==2.15.0, customtkinter==5.2.2, matplotlib==3.8.4, Pillow==10.4.0, numpy==1.26.4, opencv-python==4.12.0.88. Note: all are already installed under C:\Users\Mahek\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python311\.
